name: react-embed-demo-native
description: React Native screen embedded in the react_embed_demo Flutter app through flutter_react_embed.

scripts.bundle:android: react-native bundle --platform android --dev false --entry-file react_native/index.js --bundle-output assets/rn/index.android.bundle --assets-dest build/rn-assets/android
scripts.bundle:ios: react-native bundle --platform ios --dev false --entry-file react_native/index.js --bundle-output assets/rn/main.jsbundle --assets-dest build/rn-assets/ios
scripts.bundle: npm run bundle:android && npm run bundle:ios
